params:

---

```{r}
#| label: setup
report <- readRDS(params$data_file)
explorer <- report$explorer
compare <- report$compare

show_table <- function(x, ...) {
  knitr::kable(x, row.names = FALSE, ...)
}
```

Generated on `r report$generated`.

## Explorer summary

```{r}
#| label: explorer
#| results: asis
if (is.null(explorer)) {
  cat("No dataset was loaded in the Explorer.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf(
    "Dataset **%s**: %s rows and %s variables.\n",
    explorer$name,
    format(explorer$n_rows, big.mark = ","),
    format(explorer$n_cols, big.mark = ",")
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: explorer-table
if (!is.null(explorer)) {
  summary <- explorer$summary
  numeric_cols <- c("min", "median", "mean", "max")
  summary[numeric_cols] <- lapply(summary[numeric_cols], round, digits = 2)
  show_table(summary)
}
```

## Compare results

```{r}
#| label: compare
#| results: asis
if (is.null(compare)) {
  cat("No comparison was run.\n")
} else if (isTRUE(compare$identical)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "**%s** and **%s** are identical: no differences were found.\n",
    compare$base_name, compare$compare_name
  ))
} else {
  cat(sprintf(
    "Comparing **%s** (base) with **%s**: %d issue(s) found.\n",
    compare$base_name, compare$compare_name, nrow(compare$table)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-table
if (!is.null(compare) && !isTRUE(compare$identical)) {
  show_table(compare$table)
}
```
